notes: Cumulative custom Notes rebuild on stable v0.2.25. Replaces the generic six text boxes with a dedicated Notes workspace: repeatable Aliases; removable Tags chips; a real Mood Board that imports images, copies them into The Files' separate Data\Media\MoodBoards storage, displays thumbnails, and supports reorder/remove while preserving legacy mood-board notes; removable Aesthetic Tags chips; Color Palette swatches added through a color picker; and repeatable Important Objects with separate name and notes fields. Preserves Timeline including the Host-variable fix, Story, Powers, updater behavior, and separate user data. All internal per-file SHA-256 values were recomputed and verified, TheFilesCore.ps1.gz decompresses exactly to TheFilesCore.ps1, and Windows PowerShell parsing passed before publish.
